result.instructions: Tools for Wheelhouse, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my listings are priced below their recommendation for the next 30 nights?"; "Show the reservations for my Lisbon apartment in December."; "Set a 10% adjustment on weekends for 20 to 23 December on the beach house.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Wheelhouse data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run wheelhouse_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run wheelhouse_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run wheelhouse_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. wheelhouse_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: wheelhouse_list_listings
tools.title: List listings
tools.description: List the listings in your Wheelhouse portfolio with their id, channel, wheelhouse_id, title, market, currency and active state. Call this first: other tools need the id and channel values from here. RM API: GET /listings.

exclude_inactive.description: Leave out listings Wheelhouse no longer syncs (default true in the API).

owner_user_id.description: Only listings owned by this user id.

page.description: Page number (1-based). Do not combine with offset.

tools.name: wheelhouse_get_listing
tools.title: Get a listing
tools.description: Get one listing with its title, location, room and property type, preferences summary and market. RM API: GET /listings/{listing_id}.

listing_id.description: listing_id from wheelhouse_list_listings (the channel listing id), or the wheelhouse_id when channel is "wheelhouse".

channel.description: channel field from wheelhouse_list_listings for this listing, or "wheelhouse" when listing_id is a wheelhouse_id.

tools.name: wheelhouse_add_listing_note
tools.title: Add a listing note
tools.description: WRITE: create a note on a listing, optionally for a stay-date range and settings sections. Does not change prices. RM API: POST /listings/{listing_id}/notes.

listing_id.description: listing_id from wheelhouse_list_listings (the channel listing id), or the wheelhouse_id when channel is "wheelhouse".

channel.description: channel field from wheelhouse_list_listings for this listing, or "wheelhouse" when listing_id is a wheelhouse_id.

category.description: Settings sections the note relates to, for example base_price, minimum_stays, calendar.

start_date.description: First stay date the note applies to (needs end_date).

end_date.description: Last stay date the note applies to (needs start_date).

tools.name: wheelhouse_sync_listing
tools.title: Sync a listing now
tools.description: WRITE: trigger a manual sync of one listing with its channel. Safe to repeat. RM API: POST /listings/{listing_id}/sync.

listing_id.description: listing_id from wheelhouse_list_listings (the channel listing id), or the wheelhouse_id when channel is "wheelhouse".

channel.description: channel field from wheelhouse_list_listings for this listing, or "wheelhouse" when listing_id is a wheelhouse_id.

tools.name: wheelhouse_set_custom_rate
tools.title: Set a custom rate
tools.description: WRITE, CHANGES LIVE PRICES: set a custom rate for a listing over a date range. fixed = a nightly price per weekday (needs currency). adjustment = percent of the recommendation per weekday (100 = no change). Delete it with wheelhouse_delete_custom_rates. RM API: PUT /listings/{listing_id}/custom_rates.

listing_id.description: listing_id from wheelhouse_list_listings (the channel listing id), or the wheelhouse_id when channel is "wheelhouse".

channel.description: channel field from wheelhouse_list_listings for this listing, or "wheelhouse" when listing_id is a wheelhouse_id.

start_date.description: First date of the rate, YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: Last date of the rate, YYYY-MM-DD.

rate_type.description: fixed: nightly price. adjustment: percent of the recommendation.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code. Required for fixed rates.

sunday.description: Rate for this weekday. fixed: nightly price. adjustment: percent, where 100 = no change, 110 = +10%.

monday.description: Rate for this weekday. fixed: nightly price. adjustment: percent, where 100 = no change, 110 = +10%.

tuesday.description: Rate for this weekday. fixed: nightly price. adjustment: percent, where 100 = no change, 110 = +10%.

wednesday.description: Rate for this weekday. fixed: nightly price. adjustment: percent, where 100 = no change, 110 = +10%.

thursday.description: Rate for this weekday. fixed: nightly price. adjustment: percent, where 100 = no change, 110 = +10%.

friday.description: Rate for this weekday. fixed: nightly price. adjustment: percent, where 100 = no change, 110 = +10%.

saturday.description: Rate for this weekday. fixed: nightly price. adjustment: percent, where 100 = no change, 110 = +10%.

expires_at.description: When the rate stops applying (ISO 8601 date-time).

tools.name: wheelhouse_delete_custom_rates
tools.title: Delete custom rates
tools.description: WRITE, CHANGES LIVE PRICES: delete the custom rates of a listing in a date range, so the recommendation applies again. RM API: DELETE /listings/{listing_id}/custom_rates.

listing_id.description: listing_id from wheelhouse_list_listings (the channel listing id), or the wheelhouse_id when channel is "wheelhouse".

channel.description: channel field from wheelhouse_list_listings for this listing, or "wheelhouse" when listing_id is a wheelhouse_id.
